reuse.why: It uses the existing shouldBudgetCategory and averageToBudgetAmount helpers, getSheetValue, batchMessages, and mutator/undoable registration. It reuses the 'average' action mode rather than naming its own mode.

duplication.why: It copies the category SELECT and the batch/filter/setBudget loop scaffold that every month-wide action already repeats, instead of sharing them.

placement.why: The action sits in actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with the same wrappers.

scope.why: The change is limited to the new action, its registration and one test.

maintainability.why: It follows the established pattern exactly, so it is easy to own, but it adds one more copy of the category query and loop.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection and the sign rule go through month-budget-categories.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied category SQL in setLastMonthSpending is visible verbatim, not disguised.
